_about: Sources for the Google Images step of gather-photo-candidates.py (IMAGES.md → 'When Commons has no suitable photo'). official_with_permission: tourism boards and parks agencies (and trail bodies such as Walking SA), whose photos the owner may use: 'official photo, used with permission'. Add a region's own tourism and parks sites before its run. excluded: hosts whose images are never usable (stock, social, booking, aggregators); matched as substrings of the page's host.
